# UCAS IT Club (النادي التكنولوجي)

> The student technology club of the University College of Applied Sciences (UCAS). The site is in Arabic, with an English version of every page under /en.

## What the club does

- Works in mobile apps, websites, games and multimedia
- Organised in committees (media, public relations, activities) led by an administrative board
- Publishes club news and runs student events

## Pages

- [About](/en/about): vision, mission, goals and committees
- [News](/en/news): club news and announcements
- [Events](/en/events): upcoming and past events
- [Team](/en/team): the administrative board and committees
- [Join](/en/join): membership application
- [Contact](/en/contact): email and social profiles
- Each page's Arabic version drops the /en prefix, for example [/about](/about)
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): every page in both languages
